story.fullStory:
Valencia's "Space Between" — original release 1983. Valencia Tool & Die (VT&D), was a music venue and art gallery active from 1980 through 1983 in the Mission District of San Francisco, California.

Artist: Valencia · Title: Space Between · Album: This Could Be A Possibility · Year: 2005 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Valencia - Space Between.mp4.

It was founded by Peter Belsito and Jim Stockford, and presented punk, new wave, and new music performances, as well as performance art, film, and visual art shows.

History
Valencia Tool & Die, which to a passerby appeared to be an empty store front with no signage to identify it other than the street number, was located in the Mission District at 974 Valencia.
